counter_scope: Separate diagnostic processes, exact outputs. Baseline counter binary changes only host counters/reporting, never timed. passes are planned 8-bit digit equivalents; bytes are modeled radix read/write traffic, not measured DRAM traffic. Whole-process page faults include load/output/export. Pool peaks exclude native CUDA scratch; nvidia-smi peaks are device-wide 50ms samples.

tpch.note: All 104 current cases exact. The executable exits 1 for a pre-existing advised-H05 SF10 performance ceiling failure: pristine 1b1540bc 951.29073ms, current 952.26246ms, ceiling 10.35ms. Both are exact; query kernels dominate, not dedup. One baseline diagnostic invocation, not paired H05 performance evidence.

gate_results.gpu_suites_and_cassandra: passed; complete batch plus final core legality tests
gate_results.tpch_exactness: 104/104 exact; separate H05 performance ceiling fails on both pristine baseline and current

interpretation: The combined change is retained on matched total-fixpoint and memory evidence. Sort and merge counts are unchanged on this corpus: active windows reduce radix digit work, and unit offsets disappear. Certified order sharing is checked but does not reduce sort count in these measured plans. Profiles are process-wide attribution, not timing, and broad GPU buckets are never subtracted as a claimed wall-time win.

profiles.scope: All-process kernels, including setup and output. CUDA launch backtraces attribute fresh-owned sort/unique separately; non-fresh sorts include secondary layouts and any projected set construction. Shared scan/select kernels remain other. Not paired timing and not a subtraction-based wall-time claim.
profiles.failed_memory_capture: Two --cuda-memory-usage=true captures exited 139; identical binary executes normally without that option. No memory-profile result claimed.

All primary and layout-control timed samples and separate counter runs passed complete exact comparisons.
No provider identity or nonzero directory default changed. Combined optimization retained by Main after paired/control evidence.
